The RDF graph uses three URI patterns under the `psgc:` namespace.

## URI patterns

```
psgc:entity/{code}              — entity URI
psgc:event/{date}/{seq}         — change event URI (seq = 0001, 0002, ...)
psgc:concept/{scheme}/{value}   — concept URI (for levels, classes, etc.)
```

- **`psgc:entity/{code}`** — one per Philippine administrative unit, keyed by its 10-digit PSGC
  code (see [PSGC code structure](../references/psgc.qmd)). Identity across code changes is tracked
  by the 9-digit correspondence code, not by this URI.

- **`psgc:event/{date}/{seq}`** — one per detected change in a snapshot's delta; the `{seq}` suffix
  (`0001`, `0002`, …) disambiguates multiple events on the same date.

- **`psgc:concept/{scheme}/{value}`** — concept URIs for levels (region/province/…/barangay),
  city classes (HUC/ICC/component), and other controlled vocabularies.

## Worked examples

Pulled verbatim from [`2023-10-24/delta.ttl`](https://github.com/bendlikeabamboo/barangay-boundaries-repository/blob/main/2023-10-24/delta.ttl).

**Entity URI.** A barangay that was created in this snapshot — note both the 10-digit PSGC code and
the 9-digit correspondence code on `org:identifier`, the name on `skos:prefLabel`, and its level
(`Bgy`) plus urban/rural classification as `org:classification` concepts:

```turtle
<https://psgc.gov.ph/entity/1381500036> a org:OrganizationalUnit ;
    dct:date "2023-10-24"^^xsd:date ;
    schema1:population 15103 ;
    skos:prefLabel "Rizal"@en ;
    org:classification <https://psgc.gov.ph/concept/geographic-level/Bgy>,
        <https://psgc.gov.ph/concept/urban-rural/U> ;
    org:identifier "137602033"^^xsd:string,
        "1381500036"^^xsd:string,
        "137602033"^^psgc:correspondence-code .
```

**Creation event URI.** A `creation` carries only the resulting organization:

```turtle
<https://psgc.gov.ph/event/2023-10-24/0000> a org:ChangeEvent ;
    dct:date "2023-10-24"^^xsd:date ;
    dct:description "Aniban 1 (Bgy) created"@en ;
    org:classification <https://psgc.gov.ph/concept/change-type/creation> ;
    org:resultingOrganization <https://psgc.gov.ph/entity/0402103076> .
```

**Code-change event URI.** A re-coding carries both the original and the resulting entity, so a
consumer can follow the identity from old code to new:

```turtle
<https://psgc.gov.ph/event/2023-10-24/0082> a org:ChangeEvent ;
    dct:date "2023-10-24"^^xsd:date ;
    dct:description "PSGC code changed from 1380300033 to 1381500036"@en ;
    org:classification <https://psgc.gov.ph/concept/change-type/code_change> ;
    org:originalOrganization <https://psgc.gov.ph/entity/1380300033> ;
    org:resultingOrganization <https://psgc.gov.ph/entity/1381500036> .
```

**Transfer / source provenance.** There are **no** PROV-O triples in the committed deltas linking
events to their PSA press release — the builder supports `dct:source` (legal basis) and
`prov:generatedAtTime` (effective date) but the source data does not populate them. Until that gap
closes, trace an event to its snapshot by the `dct:date` and the date embedded in the event URI
(`/event/2023-10-24/...`). See [Change-event types › Known limitations](event-types.qmd).
